result.description: List dashboards with filtering and search.

anyOf.description: Request schema for list_dashboards with clear, unambiguous types.

created_by_me.description: When true, return only items created by the current user. Can be combined with 'filters' but not with 'search'.

deleted_state.description: Surface soft-deleted (trashed) dashboards: 'only' returns just trashed dashboards, 'include' returns live and trashed together. Omit for live dashboards only (default). Trashed rows carry a non-null deleted_at and are limited to dashboards the caller can edit (the same audience that can restore them, not merely the ones they own; admins see all). This omits EXTRA_EDITORS_RESOLVER-granted and guest role-derived editorship, so some restorable dashboards may be under-enumerated. Requires the SOFT_DELETE feature flag to have produced trashed rows.

edited_by_me.description: When true, return only items where the current user is listed as an editor. Can be combined with 'filters' but not with 'search'. Can be combined with 'created_by_me' to return items where the current user is either the creator or an editor.

filters.description: List of filter objects (column, operator, value). Each filter is an object with 'col', 'opr', and 'value' properties. Cannot be used together with 'search'.

items.description:
Filter object for dashboard listing.
col: The column to filter on. Must be one of the allowed filter fields.
opr: The operator to use. Must be one of the supported operators.
value: The value to filter by (type depends on col and opr).

col.description: Column to filter on. Use get_schema(model_type='dashboard') for available filter columns. To filter by a person, first call find_users to resolve a name to a user ID, then filter by created_by_fk or changed_by_fk with that integer ID.

opr.description: Operator to use. Use get_schema(model_type='dashboard') for available operators.

value.description: Value to filter by (type depends on col and opr)

force_refresh.description: Invalidate cache and fetch fresh data

order_column.description: Sortable columns: id, dashboard_title, slug, published, changed_on, created_on; changed_on_delta_humanized is an alias for changed_on.

refresh_metadata.description: Refresh metadata cache for schema changes

search.description: Search matches titles and slugs only, not people. Resolve names with find_users and filter by created_by_fk or changed_by_fk using the user ID. Mutually exclusive with 'filters'.

select_columns.description: List of columns to select. Defaults to common columns if not specified.

request.description: Wrap parameters as {"request": {"search": "sales"}}; omit request for defaults. Do NOT pass search, page, page_size or filters as top-level arguments. For people, resolve IDs with find_users and use filters, not search.

result.name: list_dashboards
result.title: List dashboards

result.description:
Compact, paged catalog of databases, datasets, charts or dashboards.

Only returns assets the caller can see, with id, uuid, name, description,
changed_on and url. No SQL, connection details, params or metrics.

request.description: Request for one bounded page of the caller's asset catalog.

asset_type.description: Asset type to list: databases, datasets, charts or dashboards

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous call with the same asset_type and search; omit for the first page

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the asset name

result.name: get_catalog
result.title: Get asset catalog

result.description:
Restore a soft-deleted dashboard from trash.

Identify the dashboard by numeric ID or UUID string (slug lookup does not
cover trashed dashboards).

identifier.description: Dashboard identifier - numeric ID or UUID string.

result.name: restore_dashboard
result.title: Restore dashboard

result.description:
Resolve a person's name to user IDs so they can be used as filter values.

Use this when the caller asks "show me <person>'s dashboards/charts/datasets"
or "what is <person> working on".

request.description:
Request schema for find_users tool.

Resolves a person's name (or partial name or username) to user IDs
so they can be passed to listing tools as filter values for created_by_fk
or changed_by_fk. This is the only sanctioned path for "show me what
<person> is working on" queries.

page_size.description: Maximum number of matches to return (max 100).

query.description: Substring to match (case-insensitive) against username, first_name, and last_name (never email; email-shaped queries are rejected). Required and non-empty: this tool does not enumerate the full user directory.

result.name: find_users
result.title: Find users

result.description: Get dashboard info by ID, UUID, slug, or permalink.

request.description: Wrap {"request": {...}}. Filtered? Use permalink_key/filter_state: snapshots, not query predicates; heed scope/native_filter_values_incomplete. Missing state != no filters. Don't guess columns/query workspace-wide; clarify. Charts: list_charts.

filter_state.description: Direct active filters describing the user's dashboard view. Accepts dashboard dataMask state, e.g. {"dataMask": {"<configured filter ID>": {"filterState": {"value": ["EMEA"]}}}}, or {"applied_filters": [{"col": "region", "op": "IN", "val": ["EMEA"]}]}. Ignored when permalink_key is provided. Use returned filter_state as context. Restricted users receive native_filter_values (names, types, values, labels, exclusion flags), not raw dataMask/column targets. native_filter_values_incomplete flags unsupported filters/chart state that cannot be summarized safely.

force_refresh.description: Invalidate cache and fetch fresh data

identifier.description: Dashboard ID, UUID, slug, bare permalink key, or a shared URL containing /superset/dashboard/p/<key>/. Omit when permalink_key is provided.

permalink_key.description: Key from a shared dashboard URL such as '/superset/dashboard/p/<key>/'. Resolves the dashboard and returns the shared active-tab and filter context; no identifier is required.

refresh_metadata.description: Refresh metadata cache for schema changes

select_columns.description: Top-level response fields; defaults exclude 'css' (raw CSS, potentially KBs) and 'filter_state' (shared/applied filter context). Override with e.g. ['id','dashboard_title','charts'], or add 'css' for raw CSS. Charts/native_filters may be capped: check chart_count and _truncation_notes. For all charts, call list_charts with request={"filters": [{"col": "dashboards", "opr": "eq", "value": <dashboard id>}]} and paginate with page/page_size.

result.name: get_dashboard_info
result.title: Get dashboard info
